Select: chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, efo_id AS indication_curie, efo_term AS indication_label, max_phase_for_ind
Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication
Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno
Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind = 4
Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, mesh_id ASC, mesh_heading ASC, indication_curie ASC, indication_label ASC, max_phase_for_ind ASC
Limit: NULL
